title: An old photo restored, coloured and moving
pitch: A faded black-and-white photo of an invented couple in. Restored, in colour, moving, with music of its time out.
why: The photo is made up, so no real person is brought back. Qwen-Image 2.1 removes the damage and adds colour in one edit, Wan 2.2 moves it gently, and ACE-Step writes the music.

models.name: Qwen-Image 2.1
models.note: Not Apache: read the 2.1 terms before commercial use.

tips: Use this only on photos you have the right to change, and never to put words or actions on a real person.

steps.label: The old photo

57:27.text: An old faded black and white photograph from the 1950s of an invented middle-aged couple dancing together at a seaside pavilion, both fully dressed in 1950s evening clothes, scratches, creases, dust spots, faded corners, film grain.

steps.does: An invented couple, aged on purpose.

steps.label: Restored in colour

5.prompt: Restore this photograph: remove every scratch, crease, dust spot and stain, recover the faded areas, then colourise it naturally with warm 1950s film colours. Keep the people, their faces, poses, clothes and the framing exactly the same.

steps.does: One edit: damage out, colour in, same people and framing.

steps.label: Moving
steps.prompt: The couple sway slowly together as they dance, a gentle sea breeze moves her dress, soft evening light. Natural, gentle motion. The camera stays still.

94.tags: 1950s slow swing ballad, soft brushed drums, upright bass, warm muted trumpet, gentle, no vocals

steps.label: Picture and music
steps.does: Lays the music under the clip.
